# text — encoding, layout, pagination, 16x16 font (DESIGN.md §5/§17.1)
#
# The 261,696 B hz16_gb2312.bin and 29,792 B gb2312_map.bin are generated by
# tools/gen_hz16.py and tools/gen_gb2312_map.py (text work package) and are
# committed under assets/. They are REQUIRED at configure time: without them
# map_validate() leaves s_map_ok=false and every CJK glyph renders as a 16 px
# hollow box. Always pass them to EMBED_FILES — deciding at configure time with
# if(EXISTS) is what let an image built from a stale build directory ship
# without the font. A missing asset now fails the build here, and the files are
# configure dependencies so an asset appearing/disappearing reruns CMake.
#
# 许可(T8):assets/HZK16_87.bin 及由 --from-hzk16 生成的 hz16_gb2312.bin
# 字模许可不明,仅限内部/自用构建;对外发行前必须用
# tools/gen_hz16.py --from-ttf 重新生成(docs/FONT.md §5、assets/NOTICE.md)。
#
# 两份资产分别检查、分别定义 TEXT_ASSET_*_EMBEDDED:这样"只嵌入一份"时
# text_internal.h/text_font.c 不会声明另一份的 _binary_* 符号;任一缺失仍
# 在 configure 阶段 FATAL_ERROR,给出明确报错而不是链接期符号错误。
set(_text_assets "")
set(_text_defs "")
foreach(_pair
        "hz16_gb2312.bin;TEXT_ASSET_HZ16_EMBEDDED"
        "gb2312_map.bin;TEXT_ASSET_MAP_EMBEDDED")
    list(GET _pair 0 _a)
    list(GET _pair 1 _def)
    set(_a_path "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/assets/${_a}")
    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${_a_path}")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${_a_path}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "text: missing ${_a_path} (needed for ${_def})\n"
            "run: python3 tools/gen_gb2312_map.py && python3 tools/gen_hz16.py --from-hzk16")
    endif()
    list(APPEND _text_assets "${_a_path}")
    list(APPEND _text_defs "${_def}=1")
endforeach()

idf_component_register(SRC_DIRS "."
                       INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
                       PRIV_INCLUDE_DIRS "."
                       REQUIRES common display
                       EMBED_FILES ${_text_assets})

target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE ${_text_defs})
message(STATUS "text: embedding ${_text_assets} (${_text_defs})")
